newsitem.title: USA: Game Financial wins Trump casino contract.
newsitem.headline: Game Financial wins Trump casino contract.

text.p: Game Financial Corp said Wednesday it has received a contract to provide its GameCash check cashing services at Trump Casino, Buffington Harbor, Ind.
The company's GameCash service will become operational during the first quarter of 1997, Game Financial said.

The company is currently operating in 77 locations up from 28 at the end of 1995. Including the location announced today, Game Financial has agreements in place with five additional gaming establishments that will become operational during the first quarter of 1997.

Game Financial provides gaming establishments, primarily casinos, with services that allow their patrons to access cash through the use of credit card cash advance services, check cashing services and automated teller machines (ATMs).
